name: Houndfeeder adds 4% critical strike chance to the player and the Shadowhound (#804)
contract: Houndfeeder 705477 reads 'Increases the critical strike chance of you and your Shadow Hound by $s1%.' In the installed Spell.dbc it is passive with effect 0 = self SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT (290), BasePoints 3 (DieSides 1, so 4%), and effect 1 = 190 (SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_APPLY_AURA_TO_SUMMONS) carrying the same aura and amount at 100 yd. The player side is stock: AuraEffect::HandleAuraModCritPct feeds Player::UpdateWeaponDependentCritAuras (Player.cpp) for melee/ranged and PlayerStats/StatSystem.cpp:981 for spell crit, so both crit percentages rise by exactly 4 whatever the class base is; that is why the assertions are relative to a snapshot. The hound side is the same effect-190 area delivery as Dark Ranger. No script or SQL names 705477. The stale aura-tooltip text noted in the audit is client-only and not asserted. A fresh character's melee crit field reads 0 until a crit aura first recomputes it (measured on slot 3: Houndfeeder gave 4.664 from a 0 baseline, and exactly 4.000 after a learn and unlearn of the same passive, the primed baseline being 0.664), so the baseline is snapshotted after a priming learn and unlearn.

steps.label: Prime the crit fields with a learn
Prime the crit fields with an unlearn
Melee crit returns to its baseline
